# Official government regression fixtures

Retrieved on 12 September 2026. Reused under the Open Government Licence v3.0. These fixtures prove extraction of these particular publisher layouts; they are not a current register or a claim about any organisation.

- `gateway.pdf`: [Building Safety Regulator building control approval application data, June to August 2026](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/building-safety-regulator-building-control-approval-application-data-june-to-august-2026), published by the Building Safety Regulator.
- `debarment.pdf`: [Official debarment list](https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/69cbc2028017673ffec0f329/2025-11-17_OFFICIAL-_Debarment_List_V1.0.pdf), published by the Cabinet Office. The fixture has the original empty eight-column table; populated test rows are clearly synthetic.
